pick.name: Mercury
pick.why: $0 plan with free ACH, domestic wires and USD international wires; good API and invoicing
pick.free_limits: $0/mo base; Plus $29.90, Pro $299; non-USD wires 1% FX fee; banking via Choice Financial and Column N.A. (Mercury is not itself a bank)

alts.name: Wise Business
alts.what: Multi-currency business account with local receiving details
alts.why: Mid-market FX and local details in many currencies
alts.free_limits: US: one-time USD 31 setup fee, no monthly fee; USD wire/Swift receive USD 6.11; domestic USD receipts free; receive in 22 currencies (fees differ by country)

alts.name: Revolut Business
alts.why: Good for EU/UK teams with FX needs
alts.free_limits: UK Basic GBP 10, Grow GBP 35, Scale GBP 125 per search of Revolut's fee page; US figures conflict, unverified

decision: Mercury is the best overall business bank for a US startup: free transfers, API and invoicing. Founders outside the US usually pair a local bank with Wise Business or Revolut Business for multi-currency. Keep business money separate from personal from day one.

region_notes.US: Mercury requires a company formed in the US (or a US territory) with existing or planned US operations; it accepts non-US-resident founders except those living in countries on its restricted list, and does not accept registered-agent or PO-box addresses as the business address. Check the list before forming a US entity for banking.
region_notes.UK: Revolut Business and Wise Business are common alongside high-street accounts.
region_notes.EU: Wise and Revolut offer local IBANs.
region_notes.India: Indian founders of a US company can usually open Mercury (check its restricted list) but owning that company is an Overseas Direct Investment under FEMA. For an Indian entity, open a current account that handles export receipts and issues e-FIRC/e-BRC (RazorpayX is a layer on a bank, not a bank).

verify.note: Mercury pricing verified ($0, Plus $29.90, Pro $299; free ACH and domestic wires; free USD international wires; 1% FX on non-USD wires). Eligibility per Mercury support (page 403 to fetcher, text via search): company must be formed in the US or a US territory, founders need not be US citizens or residents, founders living in certain listed countries are excluded, US operations existing or planned, registered-agent/PO box addresses not accepted, restricted industries excluded.
